notes:
REF-BM-02: No remote metadata collection is implemented.
REF-BM-03: Title is editable before and after saving, but description and auto-collected metadata are absent.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, tags, and note are editable, but there is no description field.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs trigger a warning but still create another bookmark instead of converging to editing the existing one.
REF-BM-07: The list exposes title and tags, but lacks description and favicon.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated input with no autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, URL, and note but no description field exists.
REF-BM-14: The search treats #tag as ordinary text and does not parse tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are not parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases receive no exact-match handling.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action support.
REF-BM-21: There is no filtered whole-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-22: Ordering is fixed to date added descending with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but Markdown is rendered only as plain text.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF preservation exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-26: No archival state or default-list exclusion exists.
REF-BM-27: Archive/restore behavior is absent; only permanent deletion exists.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks view exists.
REF-BM-29: Bundles and reusable saved filters are absent.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is absent.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is absent.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are absent.
